perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.description: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.description: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Nano-Assault
perks.description: Quicksilver nanites that attach to the wielder charge the blade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  when fully charged to overclock the attached nanites, enhancing the blade's offensive capabilities. Light attacks deal increased damage to targets; fully charged Heavy attacks create a flaming Quicksilver swarm-nado.

perks.name: Tenacious Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain greatly increased damage resistance from being in combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Rampager's Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain moderately increased damage resistance from being in combat for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Unyielding Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain damage resistance from being in combat for a short duration.

catalyst.name: Attrition Orbs Refit
catalyst.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
